units.text: Jacob, little Israel. I helped you,’ says God who redeems you, Israel.
Behold, I made you like new, saw-toothed wagon wheels for threshing. You will thresh mountains, grind hills fine, and make them like dust.
You will winnow, and wind will take them and a storm scatter them. But you will rejoice among Israel’s holy ones. And they will exult—
Now many nations have gathered against you, saying, “We will rejoice over her, and our eyes will look upon Zion!”
But they did not know the Lord’s thought or understand His counsel, for He gathered them like sheaves of a threshing floor.

Rise and thresh them, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horns iron and your hooves bronze. With them you will melt down nations and grind many peoples fine; you will dedicate their multitude to the Lord and their strength to the Lord of all the earth.
You scatter instruments of war for Me. In you I will scatter nations, and from you I will remove kings.
In you I will scatter horse and rider; in you I will scatter chariots and their riders.
In you I will scatter young man and virgin; in you I will scatter man and woman.
In you I will scatter shepherd and flock; in you I will scatter farmer and farmland; in you I will scatter your leaders and generals.
Woe, city Ariel, against which David fought! Gather produce year after year, for you will eat with Moab.
For I will press Ariel hard, and her strength and wealth will be Mine.
I will surround you like David, set a palisade around you and set towers around you,
and your words will be humbled into the earth and sink into the earth. Your voice will be like those who speak from the earth, and your voice will weaken toward the ground.
The wealth of the ungodly will be like dust from a wheel, like drifting chaff, and it will be like a moment, immediately,
from the Lord Sabaoth. For there will be a visitation with thunder, earthquake and a great sound, a rushing storm and a consuming flame of fire.
Like someone dreaming in sleep will be the wealth of all nations who marched against Ariel, all who marched against Jerusalem, and all assembled against her and afflicting her.

They will be like people drinking and eating in sleep; when they rise, their dream is futile. As a thirsty person dreams of drinking but wakes still thirsty, his soul having hoped in vain, so will be the wealth of all nations who marched against Mount Zion.
Proclaim these things among the nations: Consecrate war! Rouse the fighters! Draw near and come up, all soldiers!
Beat your plows into swords and your sickles into lances; let the powerless say, “I am strong!”
Assemble and enter, all surrounding nations, and gather there! Let the meek become a fighter!
Let all the nations be roused and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, because there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
Send out sickles, because the vintage is at hand! Enter and tread, because the winepress is full; the vats overflow, because their evils have multiplied.
Sounds rang out in the Valley of Judgment, because the Lord’s day is near in the Valley of Judgment.
The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will sink their brightness.
The Lord will cry out from Zion and give His voice from Jerusalem; heaven and earth will shake. But the Lord will spare His people, and the Lord will strengthen the sons of Israel.
that, concerning your former conduct, you put off the old human being, which is being corrupted according to deceitful desires,
and be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
and put on the new human being, created according to God in righteousness and holiness of truth.
Therefore, putting away falsehood, let each speak truth with his neighbor, because we are members of one another.
Be angry and do not sin. Do not let the sun go down upon your anger,
nor give a place to the devil.
